examples.en: My cousin will invite eighteen friends to his birthday party.
examples.zh: 我表哥會邀請十八位朋友參加他的生日派對。

examples.en: There are eighteen students in our English class.
examples.zh: 我們的英文課有十八個學生。

examples.en: The bus ride to the museum takes eighteen minutes.
examples.zh: 搭公車到博物館要花十八分鐘。

examples.en: At eighteen, my cousin left home to study at university.
examples.zh: 我表哥十八歲時離家去上大學。

examples.en: Nine plus nine makes eighteen, as our math teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如數學老師所解釋的，九加九等於十八。

examples.en: The player wore number eighteen on his jersey.
examples.zh: 那位球員的球衣背號是十八號。

examples.en: My grandfather is eighty years old this year.
examples.zh: 我爺爺今年八十歲了。

examples.en: The store sells eighty kinds of tea.
examples.zh: 這家店賣八十種茶。

examples.en: We drove eighty kilometers to reach the lake.
examples.zh: 我們開了八十公里的車才到達湖邊。

examples.en: Eighty is a big number for a small class.
examples.zh: 對小班級來說，八十是很大的數字。

examples.en: She lived to be nearly eighty and stayed active throughout her life.
examples.zh: 她活到將近八十歲，一生都保持活躍。

examples.en: Ten times eight is eighty, as shown on the board.
examples.zh: 如黑板上所示，十乘以八等於八十。

examples.en: We need eleven tickets for the movie on Friday night.
examples.zh: 我們需要十一張星期五晚上的電影票。

examples.en: Our soccer team has eleven players on the field.
examples.zh: 我們的足球隊場上有十一名球員。

examples.en: My little brother is eleven years old.
examples.zh: 我弟弟十一歲。

examples.en: In our class, the number eleven comes right after ten.
examples.zh: 在我們班上，十一號緊接在十號之後。

examples.en: The meeting ended at eleven, just before our lunch break.
examples.zh: 會議在十一點結束，正好在我們午休之前。

examples.en: Tom wears number eleven on his back.
examples.zh: 湯姆背上穿的是十一號球衣。

examples.en: She speaks English very well and often helps foreign visitors.
examples.zh: 她的英語說得很好，經常幫助外國遊客。

examples.en: English is my favorite subject at school.
examples.zh: 英文是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.en: Do you know how to say this in English?
examples.zh: 你知道這個用英語怎麼說嗎？

senses.zh: 英國的；英語的；英格蘭的

examples.en: We read an English novel in class last week.
examples.zh: 我們上週在課堂上讀了一本英文小說。

examples.en: He has an English teacher from London.
examples.zh: 他有一位來自倫敦的英籍老師。

examples.en: My aunt ordered a full English breakfast at the hotel.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在飯店點了一份全套英式早餐。

examples.en: There were tourists everywhere in the old street.
examples.zh: 老街上到處都是觀光客。

examples.en: I looked everywhere for my keys before leaving for school.
examples.zh: 出門上學前，我到處找我的鑰匙。

examples.en: Everywhere we went, people were kind to us.
examples.zh: 無論我們去哪裡，大家都對我們很親切。

examples.en: I have a math exam on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我星期一早上有數學考試。

examples.en: She studied all night for the final exam.
examples.zh: 她為了期末考念了一整晚的書。

examples.en: The doctor gave him a full eye exam.
examples.zh: 醫生為他做了完整的視力檢查。

examples.en: My birthday is in February, two weeks after my sister's.
examples.zh: 我的生日在二月，比姊姊的生日晚兩週。

examples.en: It is still cold in Taipei in February.
examples.zh: 二月的台北仍然很冷。

examples.en: The school trip is planned for the second week of February.
examples.zh: 校外教學預計在二月的第二週舉行。

examples.en: The class is fifteen minutes shorter on Fridays.
examples.zh: 星期五的課少十五分鐘。

examples.en: She bought fifteen apples at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場買了十五顆蘋果。

examples.en: My sister is fifteen years old and attends high school.
examples.zh: 我姊姊十五歲，目前就讀高中。

examples.en: Fifteen is half of thirty, as our teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如老師所解釋的，十五是三十的一半。

examples.en: Please come back at fifteen past four.
examples.zh: 請在四點十五分回來。

examples.en: The boys' team practices on court fifteen.
examples.zh: 男生隊在十五號球場練習。

examples.en: The tickets for the school concert cost fifty dollars each.
examples.zh: 學校音樂會的票每張五十元。

examples.en: My aunt is fifty years old and works as a nurse.
examples.zh: 我阿姨五十歲，職業是護理師。

examples.en: Fifty students joined the school choir this year.
examples.zh: 今年有五十位學生加入學校合唱團。

examples.en: Fifty is the number printed on my new team jersey.
examples.zh: 我新球衣上印的背號是五十號。

examples.en: He started a new business in his fifties.
examples.zh: 他在五十多歲時開創了新事業。

examples.en: She scored fifty on the test and decided to study harder.
examples.zh: 她考試得了五十分，決定更加用功。

examples.en: We watched a funny film on Saturday night.
examples.zh: 我們星期六晚上看了一部好笑的電影。

examples.en: My father still uses film in his old camera.
examples.zh: 我爸爸的舊相機還在用底片。

examples.en: A thin film of dust covered the table.
examples.zh: 桌上蓋著一層薄薄的灰塵。

examples.en: They will film the school play next week.
examples.zh: 他們下週要拍攝學校的話劇。

examples.en: The tourist filmed the sunset from the boat.
examples.zh: 那位遊客在船上拍攝夕陽。

examples.en: Part of the movie was filmed in Tainan.
examples.zh: 這部電影有一部分是在台南拍攝的。

examples.en: There are five people in my family.
examples.zh: 我家有五個人。

examples.en: The train leaves in five minutes, so we should hurry.
examples.zh: 火車五分鐘後出發，所以我們得趕快。

examples.en: She bought five notebooks for the new term.
examples.zh: 她為新學期買了五本筆記本。

examples.en: Five is the number between four and six on this chart.
examples.zh: 在這張表上，五是介於四和六之間的數字。

examples.en: Our school ends at five on Wednesdays.
examples.zh: 我們學校星期三五點放學。

examples.en: He wore the number five on his shirt.
examples.zh: 他的球衣上印著五號。

examples.en: There are forty desks in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡有四十張課桌。

examples.en: My uncle is forty years old and works at a bank.
examples.zh: 我叔叔四十歲，在銀行工作。

examples.en: The bus takes forty minutes to get downtown.
examples.zh: 這班公車要四十分鐘才到市區。

examples.en: Forty is four times ten, as our teacher explained.
examples.zh: 正如老師所解釋的，四十是十的四倍。

examples.en: My mother just turned forty and celebrated with her friends.
examples.zh: 我媽媽剛滿四十歲，並和朋友們一起慶祝。

examples.en: Our train arrives at platform forty in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我們的火車十分鐘後抵達四十號月台。

examples.en: There are four seasons in a year.
examples.zh: 一年有四個季節。

examples.en: We ordered four bowls of noodles for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐點了四碗麵。

examples.en: My brother has four pencils in his bag.
examples.zh: 我弟弟的書包裡有四枝鉛筆。

examples.en: Four is an even number, just like six and eight.
examples.zh: 四和六、八一樣，都是偶數。

examples.en: The store closes at four on Sundays.
examples.zh: 這家店星期日四點打烊。

examples.en: Write a four in the box next to your name.
examples.zh: 在你名字旁邊的方框裡寫一個四。

examples.en: My cousin is fourteen years old and loves playing basketball.
examples.zh: 我表妹十四歲，很喜歡打籃球。

examples.en: There are fourteen days in two weeks.
examples.zh: 兩週有十四天。

examples.en: The school library has fourteen computers for students to use.
examples.zh: 學校圖書館有十四台電腦供學生使用。

examples.en: Fourteen is an even number between thirteen and fifteen.
examples.zh: 十四是介於十三和十五之間的偶數。

examples.en: The bus leaves from gate fourteen.
examples.zh: 這班公車從十四號乘車處出發。

examples.en: Girls under fourteen can join the junior team.
examples.zh: 未滿十四歲的女孩可以加入青少年隊。

examples.en: We have a quiz every Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期五早上都有小考。

examples.en: Friday is the last school day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期五是一週中最後一個上課日。

examples.en: Let's meet at the station on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們星期五下午在車站碰面吧。

examples.en: The kids played frisbee in the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 孩子們午餐後在公園玩飛盤。

examples.en: He threw the frisbee across the field to his dog.
examples.zh: 他把飛盤丟過草地給他的狗。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my frisbee to the beach.
examples.zh: 我忘了把飛盤帶去海邊。

examples.en: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
examples.zh: 氧氣是我們呼吸所需的一種氣體。

examples.en: Please turn off the gas before you leave the kitchen.
examples.zh: 離開廚房前請把瓦斯關掉。

examples.en: We stopped to buy gas on the way to Hualien.
examples.zh: 我們在前往花蓮的路上停下來加油。

examples.en: Her granddaughter visits her every weekend and brings her lunch.
examples.zh: 她的孫女每個週末都會來探望她，並帶午餐給她。

examples.en: The old man bought a doll for his granddaughter.
examples.zh: 那位老先生為他的孫女買了一個玩偶。

examples.en: My grandmother's first granddaughter was born in May.
examples.zh: 我奶奶的第一個孫女出生在五月。

examples.en: Their grandson lives in another city and calls them every week.
examples.zh: 他們的孫子住在別的城市，每週都會打電話給他們。

examples.en: The old woman made soup for her grandson.
examples.zh: 那位老太太煮湯給她的孫子喝。

examples.en: My grandfather's only grandson is learning to swim.
examples.zh: 我爺爺唯一的孫子正在學游泳。

examples.en: My dad goes to the gym after work.
examples.zh: 我爸爸下班後會去健身房。

examples.en: The school gym is open to students at noon.
examples.zh: 學校體育館中午開放給學生使用。

examples.en: They held the graduation ceremony in the gym.
examples.zh: 他們在體育館舉行畢業典禮。

examples.en: Children wear costumes on Halloween and collect candy from neighbors.
examples.zh: 孩子們在萬聖節會穿上各種裝扮，向鄰居要糖果。

examples.en: Our class held a small party for Halloween.
examples.zh: 我們班為萬聖節辦了一場小派對。

examples.en: Halloween falls on October thirty-first every year.
examples.zh: 萬聖節每年都在十月三十一日。

examples.en: This umbrella is not mine; it is hers.
examples.zh: 這把傘不是我的，是她的。

examples.en: My room is bigger than hers, but hers has a balcony.
examples.zh: 我的房間比她的大，但她的房間有陽台。

examples.en: The blue notebook on the desk is hers.
examples.zh: 桌上那本藍色筆記本是她的。

examples.en: Hey, wait for me at the gate!
examples.zh: 嘿，在校門口等我！

examples.en: Hey, is this your pencil case on the floor?
examples.zh: 喂，地板上這個鉛筆盒是你的嗎？

examples.en: Hey, that was a really good idea.
examples.zh: 嘿，那真是個好主意。

examples.en: Hi, my name is Amy, and I'm your new classmate.
examples.zh: 嗨，我的名字是艾咪，我是你的新同學。

examples.en: She waved and said hi to her neighbor.
examples.zh: 她揮揮手，向鄰居打招呼。

examples.en: Hi, can I help you find something?
examples.zh: 你好，需要我幫你找什麼嗎？

examples.en: He left his umbrella on the bus.
examples.zh: 他把他的雨傘忘在公車上了。

examples.en: Tom is doing his homework in the library.
examples.zh: 湯姆正在圖書館寫他的功課。

examples.en: His sister plays the violin very well.
examples.zh: 他的姊姊小提琴拉得很好。

examples.en: The red bike is his, and the blue one is mine.
examples.zh: 那輛紅色腳踏車是他的，藍色那輛是我的。

examples.en: I forgot my pen, so he lent me his.
examples.zh: 我忘了帶筆，所以他把他的借給我。

examples.en: Our team's score was higher than his.
examples.zh: 我們這隊的分數比他的高。

examples.en: My mother is a nurse at the hospital.
examples.zh: 我媽媽是醫院的護理師。

examples.en: The weather is cold today, so wear a coat.
examples.zh: 今天天氣很冷，所以要穿外套。

examples.en: Where is the nearest bus stop for the airport bus?
examples.zh: 最近的機場巴士站在哪裡？

examples.en: School starts again in late January after the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假過後，學校在一月下旬重新開學。

examples.en: We celebrate the New Year in January.
examples.zh: 我們在一月慶祝新年。

examples.en: It rained almost every day last January.
examples.zh: 去年一月幾乎天天下雨。

examples.en: We go to the beach every July.
examples.zh: 我們每年七月都會去海邊。

examples.en: Summer vacation begins in July and lasts for two months.
examples.zh: 暑假從七月開始，為期兩個月。

examples.en: Her family will visit Japan in July.
examples.zh: 她的家人七月要去日本玩。

examples.en: My sister will graduate from high school in June.
examples.zh: 我姊姊六月要從高中畢業了。

examples.en: The weather gets hot and humid in June.
examples.zh: 六月的天氣變得又熱又潮濕。

examples.en: The school's sports day is on the first Saturday of June.
examples.zh: 學校的運動會在六月的第一個星期六舉行。

examples.en: The kitten is sleeping on the sofa.
examples.zh: 小貓正睡在沙發上。

examples.en: We found a kitten behind the school.
examples.zh: 我們在學校後面發現一隻小貓。

examples.en: She named her new kitten Lucky when she brought it home.
examples.zh: 她把新小貓帶回家時，為牠取名叫幸運。

examples.en: Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your scarf.
examples.zh: 不好意思，女士，您的圍巾掉了。

examples.en: Yes, ma'am, I will finish the report before noon.
examples.zh: 好的，女士，我會在中午前完成這份報告。

examples.en: Can I take your order now, ma'am, or do you need more time?
examples.zh: 女士，現在可以為您點餐了嗎，還是您需要多一點時間？

examples.en: Math is my favorite subject in school.
examples.zh: 數學是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.en: I have a lot of math homework tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚有很多數學作業。

examples.en: Our math teacher explains hard problems very clearly.
examples.zh: 我們的數學老師把難題講解得很清楚。

examples.en: I have piano lessons every Monday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我每個星期一下午都要上鋼琴課。

examples.en: Monday is the first school day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期一是一週中的第一個上課日。

examples.en: The new store will open next Monday.
examples.zh: 新的商店下星期一開幕。

examples.en: The baby's playful movements made everyone in the room laugh.
examples.zh: 寶寶逗趣的動作讓房間裡的每個人都笑了。

examples.en: Slow movement helps the dancers stay in balance.
examples.zh: 緩慢的動作讓舞者保持平衡。

examples.en: The student movement began at the university.
examples.zh: 這場學生運動是從大學裡開始的。

examples.en: We take the MRT to school every morning.
examples.zh: 我們每天早上搭捷運上學。

examples.en: The MRT station is a five-minute walk from my house.
examples.zh: 捷運站離我家走路只要五分鐘。

examples.en: The MRT is faster than the bus during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段，捷運比公車快。

examples.en: I left my backpack on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把我的背包忘在公車上了。

examples.en: My brother is learning to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 我弟弟正在學彈吉他。

examples.en: She is my best friend at school.
examples.zh: 她是我在學校最好的朋友。

senses.zh: 好看的；漂亮的；外表出色的

examples.en: She bought a nice-looking dress for the party.
examples.zh: 她為派對買了一件好看的洋裝。

examples.en: That nice-looking man works at the bank.
examples.zh: 那位長得好看的男士在銀行工作。

examples.en: The café has a very nice-looking garden.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡店有一座很漂亮的花園。

examples.en: My older sister is nineteen years old.
examples.zh: 我姊姊十九歲。

examples.en: There are nineteen books on the shelf.
examples.zh: 書架上有十九本書。

examples.en: The train arrives in nineteen minutes, so we should hurry.
examples.zh: 火車十九分鐘後到站，所以我們得趕快。

examples.en: Nineteen comes right after eighteen in the counting song.
examples.zh: 在數數歌裡，十九緊接在十八之後。

examples.en: He joined the army at nineteen after finishing high school.
examples.zh: 他高中畢業後，在十九歲時入伍。

examples.en: Nineteen is the number printed on my ticket for the tour.
examples.zh: 我的旅遊行程票券上印的號碼是十九號。

examples.en: My great-grandmother is ninety years old and still lives independently.
examples.zh: 我曾祖母九十歲了，仍然獨立生活。

examples.en: The test lasts ninety minutes, so please manage your time carefully.
examples.zh: 這場考試為時九十分鐘，請妥善分配時間。

examples.en: Ninety students took part in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 有九十位學生參加了演講比賽。

examples.en: Ninety is the number printed on the front of his jersey.
examples.zh: 他球衣正面印的背號是九十號。

examples.en: She scored a ninety on the English test.
examples.zh: 她的英文考試拿了九十分。

examples.en: Grandpa lived to be nearly ninety and enjoyed gardening every day.
examples.zh: 爺爺活到將近九十歲，每天都享受園藝的樂趣。

examples.en: The weather gets cooler in November, so remember to bring a jacket.
examples.zh: 十一月的天氣變得比較涼，所以記得帶件外套。

examples.en: My cousin's wedding is in November at a hotel near the station.
examples.zh: 我表姊的婚禮十一月在車站附近的飯店舉行。

examples.en: We will visit Kyoto in November next year to see the autumn leaves.
examples.zh: 我們明年十一月要去京都看秋葉。

examples.en: The shop opens at nine o'clock, just after breakfast.
examples.zh: 這家商店九點鐘開門，正好是早餐過後。

examples.en: Dinner is ready at seven o'clock, so please come home before then.
examples.zh: 晚餐七點鐘準備好，請在那之前回家。

examples.en: Please be at the station by eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 請在八點鐘前到車站。

examples.en: The school festival is held in October.
examples.zh: 校慶在十月舉行。

examples.en: It is still warm in Taipei in October.
examples.zh: 十月的台北仍然很溫暖。

examples.en: My family went hiking last October to enjoy the cooler weather.
examples.zh: 我們全家去年十月去健行，享受較涼爽的天氣。

examples.en: Is it ok if I sit here?
examples.zh: 我坐這裡可以嗎？

examples.en: The movie was ok, but the ending was boring.
examples.zh: 這部電影還可以，但結局很無聊。

examples.en: Are you ok after the fall?
examples.zh: 你跌倒之後還好嗎？

examples.en: Ok, let's start the lesson by reviewing yesterday's homework.
examples.zh: 好，我們先複習昨天的作業，開始今天的課。

examples.en: Ok, I will call you after dinner.
examples.zh: 好，我吃完晚餐後會打給你。

examples.en: Ok, that makes sense now that you have explained the rule.
examples.zh: 好，聽了你對規則的解釋，我現在懂了。

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個姊姊。

examples.en: Only one student passed the difficult test.
examples.zh: 只有一位學生通過了那場困難的考試。

examples.en: There is one seat left on the bus.
examples.zh: 公車上只剩下一個座位。

examples.en: One is the smallest positive whole number.
examples.zh: 一是最小的正整數。

examples.en: The party starts at one this afternoon.
examples.zh: 派對在今天下午一點開始。

examples.en: Please press one to speak with a clerk.
examples.zh: 請按一轉接店員。

examples.en: I lost my pen, so I bought a new one.
examples.zh: 我弄丟了筆，所以買了一枝新的。

examples.en: Which one do you like better, the red bag or the blue one?
examples.zh: 你比較喜歡哪一個，紅色的包包還是藍色的？

examples.en: One should always be polite to guests.
examples.zh: 對客人應該永遠保持禮貌。

examples.en: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework.
examples.zh: 我們的老師給了我們很多作業。

examples.en: We painted our classroom door green during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我們在暑假期間把教室的門漆成綠色。

examples.en: This is our first trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 這是我們第一次去日本旅行。

examples.en: This table is ours; the other one is theirs.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是我們的，另一張是他們的。

examples.en: Your house is bigger than ours and has a larger garden.
examples.zh: 你們的房子比我們的大，花園也比較大。

examples.en: The blue bus is ours, so please get on.
examples.zh: 那輛藍色的公車是我們的，請上車。

examples.en: Students cross the road by using the overpass.
examples.zh: 學生們利用天橋過馬路。

examples.en: There is a long overpass near our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一座很長的天橋。

examples.en: The bus drove under the overpass on its way downtown.
examples.zh: 公車往市區行駛途中從高架橋下方駛過。

examples.en: We have PE on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
examples.zh: 我們星期二和星期四早上有體育課。

examples.en: Our PE teacher taught us how to play badminton.
examples.zh: 我們的體育老師教我們怎麼打羽毛球。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my PE clothes to school.
examples.zh: 我忘了把體育課的衣服帶到學校。

examples.en: She put a family photo on her desk.
examples.zh: 她在書桌上放了一張全家福照片。

examples.en: Can you take a photo of us here?
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡幫我們拍張照嗎？

examples.en: The photo on the wall shows my grandfather's old house.
examples.zh: 牆上的照片是我爺爺的老房子。

examples.en: My parents were pleased with my test results.
examples.zh: 我父母對我的考試成績很滿意。

examples.en: I am pleased to meet you and welcome you to our team.
examples.zh: 很高興認識您，也歡迎您加入我們的團隊。

examples.en: The manager looked pleased with the new design.
examples.zh: 經理看起來對新設計很滿意。
